bullets: Added a 10-cent minimum click charge for ads in low-converting countries, so more ad inventory gets monetized instead of being skipped.
Added Solar Pro 4 daily session cap of one per user on the free tier, priced at $0.50 per session.
Added Solar Pro 4 zero-data-retention provider endpoint to pin its route in the catalog.
Removed the max reasoning effort rung from GLM 5.3 Flash, leaving only low and high.
GLM 5.3 Flash now defaults to high reasoning effort on chat surfaces with no effort control.
Changed the GLM 5.2 referral reward to unlock the tier-shaped GLM 5.3 Flash reward model instead of a fixed model.
Full access users now get one extra session in the shared daily premium pool from the GLM referral reward.
Added upgrade prompt beneath rate-limited and spend-limited session screens in the CLI landing screen.
Changed ad preview widths to 48, 80, 100 columns and updated the house ad layout floor.
Added placement surface resolution for missing fields like Desktop-Below-Chat to prevent null ad delivery failures.
Added three usage windows showing today, week, and month free usage in the model picker for free tier users.
Switched the thinker-gemini agent to DeepSeek V4 Flash with explicit high reasoning effort.
